items.title: A $6.4 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApollo Management Holdings, whose 13F holds $6. 43 billion of US stocks, raised its Churchill Downs stake 512% and its Primo Brands stake 121% in the third quarter, and added put options on Apple.

items.title: What Is Apple (AAPL) Planning With Its New Autonomous AI Agent?
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is building an autonomous AI agent designed to handle complex, multistep tasks for everyday users. Job postings point to a large scale buildout of AI engineering and product roles tied directly to this new assistant effort. Internal planning targets a potential consumer launch as soon as late 2027 with a core focus on on device privacy and security. Apple's autonomous AI agent push under CEO John Ternus fits into a broader shift our research is tracking at the company...

items.title: AI debt fears mount: why cash and defensive stocks are back in favor
items.summary: Ron Insana, CEO of Insana Information Partners and author of The Message of the Markets on Substack, says investors should separate long-term investing from money needed soon.

items.title: An $8.3 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA fund with $8. 3 billion in US stocks added to Apple and Coinbase and opened a new stake in HDFC Bank in the third quarter, its latest 13F shows.

items.title: Apple’s CEO Calls Memory Pricing “Unprecedented.” Its Purchase Obligations Jumped $33 Billion in a Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple CEO John Ternus called memory pricing “unprecedented” and said Apple’s manufacturing purchase obligations rose $33 billion from June to September. Memory costs look set to weigh on Apple’s gross margin into fiscal 2027, and its price increases only partly offset them.

items.title: The App Paradigm Will “Slowly, if Not Quickly, Dissipate,” Says Mark Gurman. That’s a Problem for Apple
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloomberg’s Mark Gurman said the app paradigm will “slowly, if not quickly, dissipate” as AI calls for a new kind of operating system. Alphabet’s Gemini sits under Apple’s rebuilt AI models, while AppLovin’s install-driven ad business needs apps to last.

items.title: Why is Apple Stock Holding Strong While the Rest of the Market Falls?
items.summary: Apple stock sits near its record as the S&P 500 falls, and BTIG says a stock market bottom has needed Apple to drop.

items.title: “The Selloff Does Not End When Fundamentals Improve,” Warns Gene Munster. Nvidia Looks Like 2012 Apple
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA stock is 47% below its October high, even after a beat-and-raise quarter and higher earnings estimates. Gene Munster compares NVIDIA to Apple in 2012, and he’s right that better fundamentals alone won’t end the selloff.
